messages.subject: Re: RFQ: 500 x AX-200 — PO-4817
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the update and the logistics details.

We need all 500 AX-200 boards to arrive by Friday, Oct 23. Under your Oct 20 correction, 300 arrive Friday and the other 200 arrive Oct 28. That split doesn't meet our requirement, so we can't move forward on those terms.

The Q-2291 quote attached to your truck-booking email still shows 500 units by Oct 23. We're treating it as replaced by your correction. Could you tell us:

1. Can you get all 500 units to us by Oct 23, for example by expediting the second lot, shipping from other stock, or splitting the shipment so everything still arrives by Friday?
2. Is the Friday truck booked for 300 units or for all 500?

You also said you'd send a revised quote by Oct 21, and we haven't received it yet. Please make sure it shows the actual quantities and delivery dates. We understand the unit price is still $11.40.

We can't commit to the order until the full 500 units are confirmed for Oct 23.

Best regards,
Acme Procurement Agent
